about.headline:
Not an event.
12 hours of building.
about.paragraph1: The Next Craft is the in-person hackathon by Crafter Station. 12 hours of real work, running simultaneously in Lima, Bogotá, Guatemala, Arequipa and El Salvador, with 300 hackers solving real problems.
about.paragraph2: Admission is selective. No room for spectators, no space for pretty slides. You come to ship real product: with users, with data, with something that works when the clock runs out.

place.label: PLACE
place.value: Lima · Bogotá · Guatemala · Arequipa · El Salvador

tracks.label: TRACKS
tracks.headline:
3 TRACKS.
PICK YOUR WEAPON.
tracks.intro: The bar is still one: what you build has to be used by someone real before the bell rings.

items.name: CONTENT MACHINE
items.desc: Build tools that create, edit, publish or distribute content — designed as a real product, not a demo. Something people actually use and that runs on its own.
ideas: An assistant that turns your work into content and publishes it for you
Long-form → clips, picking the best moments instead of random cuts
A tool that repurposes your old content in a smart way
Publish to several platforms at once, without it breaking
Not just generating content: measuring whether it actually lands
items.why: This is how products grow today. The challenge is making it work for real and at scale, not just in the demo.

items.name: OUT OF THE BOX
items.desc: Build something weird, experimental or unclassifiable — but with a technical spark. Real-time, novel interfaces, generative, hardware. The rule: make people react.
ideas: A voice interface that responds instantly
Something generative and live that reacts to whoever uses it
A game with characters that actually think
Something that mixes hardware or sensors with AI
An extension that does something unexpected with the page
A 'joke but useful' app with a good trick behind it
items.why: Viral projects come from here. Permission to experiment instead of building another SaaS — but done well.

items.name: LEARNING BY SHIPPING
items.desc: Build tools to learn by doing: that adapt, give real feedback and evaluate your work. No passive education — the product has to make you do.
ideas: A tutor that teaches with projects and gives you real feedback
Feedback that adapts to what you already know and what you're missing
Practice that adjusts to what you tend to forget
Practice interviews that actually evaluate you
An environment that runs and tests your code while you learn
Mentor matching that connects the right people
items.why: The education track, but with a better angle: less school, more doing.

events.description: Demos — 3 minutes per team, live product

prizes.label: PRIZES
perks: Access to the Crafter Station community
50 USD in Vapi credits per participant
50 USD in Apify credits per participant
20 USD in Cursor credits per participant
One month of n8n Cloud Pro per participant
Replit Core plan + 20 USD in development credits
prizes.winnersAria: Cash and partner credit prizes for the top three winning teams
prizes.note: Jury evaluates with live demo + pitch. We'll publish the rubric soon.

items.question: Who can apply?
items.answer: Anyone who builds: devs, designers, PMs. Admission is selective: what you've shipped matters, not your résumé.

items.question: Can I apply without a team?
items.answer: Yes. Team formation happens at the kickoff. Teams of 3 to 5.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Laptop, charger and energy. Food, coffee and power are on us.

items.question: Can I use AI?
items.answer: Yes, you can use AI. But the code must be built during the hackathon — no pre-existing code will be accepted.

items.question: Who owns the IP?
items.answer: You do. 100%. We just want to watch you ship.

items.question: Is it in-person?
items.answer: Yes, it'll be in-person in Lima, Bogotá, Guatemala, Arequipa or El Salvador — whichever hub fits you. No remote option.

items.question: How does the jury evaluate?
items.answer: Live demo + pitch. We'll publish the rubric soon.

gallery.emptyBody: When a participant generates a badge, it will show up here. If you are already accepted, you can create yours now.

roleGallery.title: Mentor and judge images

gate.title: ACCREDITED ONLY
gate.body: Sign in with the email you were accepted with. Access is checked against the guest list.
gate.noParticipantBody: Your account exists but we couldn't find your accreditation. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll check.

overview.label: DASHBOARD
overview.ledeConfirmed: You're in {track}. Code freeze is at 20:00 and demos start at 20:15.
overview.ledePending: You haven't confirmed your track. Twelve hours, one day: the track sets the criteria the judges use on you.
overview.noTeamBody: Teams are 3 to 5 people and close at the kickoff. Ask on WhatsApp to get matched.
overview.submissionNote: The validator checks your repo every hour. A failure at 20:00 isn't a warning: it's missing the demos.

tracks.label: TRACKS
tracks.headline: 3 TRACKS. PICK YOUR WEAPON.
tracks.barDraftHint: Confirming registers it for the whole team.
tracks.barConfirmedHint: You present to this track's judges.
tracks.windowClosedBody: The kickoff is over. You can still pick, but tell us on WhatsApp so staff can record the change.

credits.label: PARTNER CREDITS
credits.headline: CREDITS THAT ARE ALREADY YOURS
credits.lede: Everyone who gets in takes these credits, win or not. Reveal and redeem each available code from your participant dashboard.
credits.perPersonHint: one per person, not per team
credits.rule1: Credits marked per participant are redeemed with each member's own account, not once per team.
credits.rule2: Revealing the code counts as redeeming: the partner sees it in their panel.
credits.rule3: Use an account with some history. Brand-new accounts sometimes trip the partner's antifraud.
credits.rule4: If a code fails, message us on WhatsApp with the code and the exact error.

tavily.about: Web search for agents. Each participant can apply the coupon to their own account.
steps: Create an account or sign in to Tavily
In Billing, choose Upgrade under the Project plan
Open Add Promotion Code, paste the code, and confirm

vapi.about: Real-time voice. Extra useful if you go OUT OF THE BOX with a voice interface.
steps: Each member opens the redemption link with their own account
Sign in or create an account and confirm the coupon is applied

apify.about: Scraping and web data automation, with ready-made actors.
steps: Create an account or sign in to Apify Console
Open Billing in the sidebar
Go to the Subscription tab
Click + Add a promo code, paste the code, and confirm

cursor.about: The editor. Twenty dollars just about covers twelve hours if you don't let the agent run loose.
steps: Settings → Billing → Redeem
One code per person, not per team

elevenlabs.about: Synthetic voice and dubbing. If your product talks, this is what it sounds like.
steps: Create the account with your registration email
Subscription → Redeem code

n8n.perk: One month of Cloud Pro per participant
n8n.about: Visual automation. The top three also get a swag box for every team member.
steps: Create a 14-day trial or sign in, then click Upgrade now
Choose the Pro plan with the Monthly billing cycle
Select the plan, check the order summary, and click Add discount
Paste the code, click Apply, verify the discount, and continue

replit.about: Browser dev and deploy environment. The coupon applies to a new monthly Core subscription, which may renew at the regular price.
steps: Create an account or sign in to Replit
Open checkout and click Join Replit Core
Choose Core Monthly, not the annual plan
Open Add promotion code, enter the code, and click Apply
Verify the discount, add a payment method, and confirm

credits.codePendingBody: Your code will be assigned before the event. Check back once the team publishes it from admin.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.no-team: You need a team for this.
errors.track-locked: The track is already confirmed. Release it first.
errors.track-full: That track is well ahead of the others at your hub. Pick one with fewer teams.

badge.label: BADGE · YOUR IDENTITY
badge.headline: YOUR OFFICIAL BADGE
badge.lede: You generate the badge in Badge Studio from your photo. Its QR leads to your public profile, which is what whoever scans it sees.
badge.generatingBody: Your badge is being generated. It takes a couple of minutes; reload this page to see it.
badge.missingBody: You don't have a badge yet. It's created in Badge Studio from a photo of you.
badge.note: The badge is generated once and you can replace it. The QR is rewritten with each version, so always use the latest.
badge.qrBody: The badge QR points to your participant profile. Whoever scans it sees your name, bio and links — no email, no document.
badge.qrMissing: You'll get a profile URL once you generate the badge.

staff.label: STAFF · DOOR
staff.headline: HUB CHECK-IN
staff.lede: Search by name or email, mark arrival and hand out merch. Every mark records who made it.
staff.denied: This screen is staff only. Sign in with your organization email.
staff.reposEmpty: No team has claimed a repo yet.

team.label: TEAM
team.headlineEmpty: YOU DON'T HAVE A TEAM YET
team.ledeEmpty: Teams are {min} to {max} people and form at the kickoff. Create one and read out the code, or join with someone else's.
team.ledeTeam: Share the code so the others can join. Up to {max} people.
team.createBody: Name it and we'll give you a six-character code for the others to join with.
team.joinBody: Ask whoever created the team for the code. Six characters, case-insensitive.
team.shareBody: Read it out loud. Up to {max} people per team.
team.shortBody: The minimum is {min} people. You can carry on, but tell staff if you won't reach it.
team.pitchPlaceholder: What it does and for whom. No adjectives.
team.leaveConfirm: If you're the last one, the team is deleted and the code stops working.

github.label: TEAM REPO
github.title: GITHUB
github.body: Every team gets a repository in the organization, generated from the hackathon template. Link your GitHub and the invite lands in your inbox.
github.repoBody: Clone it and work there. Mentors find it from the organization.
github.failed: The repo could not be created.
github.waitCaptain: Whoever started the team creates it. Link your GitHub and they'll invite you.
github.captainNeedsLink: Link your GitHub first: you become the repo admin.
github.pushAccept: Accept the invite before pushing — without it GitHub answers 403. The second block replaces the starter content with yours.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.already-in-team: You're already on a team. Leave it first.
errors.name-too-short: The name needs at least two characters.
errors.code-not-found: That code doesn't exist. Check it with whoever created the team.
errors.not-captain: Only whoever started the team can create the repo.
errors.github-not-configured: The organization hasn't set up GitHub yet. Ping the staff.
errors.github-taken: That GitHub account is already linked to another registration.
errors.github-failed: GitHub didn't answer properly. Try again in a moment.
errors.repo-in-progress: The repo is already being created. Reload in a few seconds.

gate.title: ORGANIZERS ONLY
gate.body: Sign in with your organization email to manage perks and operations.
gate.denied: This area is for the organizing team only.

perks.label: ADMIN · PERKS
perks.headline: PARTNER CODES
perks.lede: Upload sponsor codes. Without email they assign in order to participants with a completed badge; with email they go directly to that person.
perks.uploadBody: Columns partner_key,code for auto-assignment, or email,partner_key,code to target someone specific.
